title: Mercury lamp
description: Spectral lamp with sharp lines at 404.7, 435.8, 546.1 and 577.0/579.1 nm (the last two are not resolved). The 546 nm line reaches the 16-bit limit (saturated). With the stored calibration the blue lines appear about 0.2-0.3 nm too high, the green one within 0.1 nm: a good exercise for the wavelength calibration.

title: Cadmium lamp
description: Spectral lamp with lines at 467.8, 480.0, 508.6 and 643.8 nm.

title: Helium-neon discharge lamp
description: Discharge lamp (not a laser): many neon lines between 580 and 700 nm, e.g. 585.2, 588.2, 614.3, 640.2 and 667.8 nm.

title: Sodium lamp
description: Dominated by the sodium D lines at 589.0 and 589.6 nm, which this spectrometer cannot resolve.

title: Sunlight
description: Daylight continuum with dark Fraunhofer absorption lines.

title: Candle flame
description: Thermal glow of the flame: a continuum rising towards the red.

title: Smartphone screen (white)
description: A white screen is made of separate red, green and blue emitters: three bands instead of a continuum.

title: Iodine absorption
description: White light through iodine vapour: the regular absorption bands of the I2 molecule around 540-580 nm (iodine experiment of the advanced lab).
